summary_markdown:
The conversation addresses a request from Esben (mentioned by [me]) to integrate the frequency formula for Gabon, originally intended for San Paolo, into the dashboard view. Currently, the frequency formula is only available for campaigns. Implementing this change would affect the count of unique users (uniques) for Brazil and Gabon.

[p1] confirmed that this implementation should proceed.
decisions: The frequency formula must be applied to dashboards for both Brazil and Gabon.
action_items: Implement the frequency formula on the dashboards for Brazil and Gabon.
